name: OSS Server (No Auth) — Enable an LLM Provider Without Integration APIs
query: Our Conductor runs at http://conductor.internal:8080/api — `conductor workflow list` works without any credentials. Set things up so our workflows can call Anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6.
expected_behavior: Step 1: A server that answers without credentials is OSS (SKILL.md Rule 17) — optionally confirm with `python3 "$CONDUCTOR_API" server-info`
Step 2: On OSS, enable Anthropic by setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the Conductor server's environment (and restarting it) — not in the client, not in workflow JSON
Step 3: Integration / model / access APIs are Orkes-only — do not run integration-save, model-sync or grant-access
Step 4: Use `llmProvider: anthropic` and `model: claude-sonnet-4-6` in an LLM_CHAT_COMPLETE task; verify with a one-task test workflow written to a file
success_criteria: Identifies the server as OSS because it requires no auth
Enables the provider by setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the Conductor server's environment (with a restart), not in the client environment or workflow
Does not call or recommend Orkes integration APIs (`integration-save`, `model-sync`, `model-save`, `grant-access`, `/api/integrations/...`) for this server
Verifies with a test workflow whose JSON is written to a file before registration
Does not fall back to an HTTP task calling api.anthropic.com
